method.title: What actually counts?
method.description: Progress uses saved start or finish dates in {{year}}, or the date added if both are missing. Older dated imports stay out. Finishes need a finish date. Lifetime hours, episodes and pages are not yearly totals. Community counts include each person's entry, not unique titles. Rankings use reviews created that year, with a bonus for favorites added that year. Records can change; this is not an immutable history. Original audio changes by category and can be muted.
